The '''Nevoota Extinction''' was a war fought between the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]]&mdash;a religious warrior culture&mdash;and the [[Nevoota/Legends|Nevoota]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. It resulted in the extinction of the Nevoota and the deification of war by the Mandalorians.
